scope: Reproduce native desktop filter hiding live window rows; explicit disposable all-desktops configuration; minimized cross-monitor storage restoration and animation containment

causes.detail: Native showOnlyCurrentDesktop defaults true. TaskFilterProxyModel checks VirtualDesktopInfo per matching QScreen. No desktop provider is available in the existing live experiment, leaving launcher rows while window source is valid.
causes.priorTestGap: The prior test disabled the native model filter directly and used nonmatching screen geometry.

causes.detail: Shared special:minimized storage can belong to another monitor. Moving a floating window to that workspace changes its monitor and positions relative to it, with animation updates.

implementation.taskPreview: Explicit --all-desktops sets only native showOnlyCurrentDesktop=false through KConfigLoader on both applets before panel creation. No QML patches, invented desktop IDs or direct TaskModel filter setter.
implementation.scopeGuards: Requires task actions, disposable follow preview and temporary canonical XDG directories; wrapper/host reject saved profile mode.
implementation.diagnostics: taskViewDiagnosticsVersion=1; native view models, active current desktop filters, visible window/group rows and launcher rows. Counts sum views, not unique physical windows; no titles or identifiers exported.
implementation.animationRule: Common no_anim=true only while workspace matches special:minimized. User configuration remains authoritative; rule stops matching on restore. Suppresses storage transfer animation, not a KWin minimize-to-icon effect.
